# Camera Capture

## Summary
How a photograph was taken: body, lens, and the three exposure settings.

## Shape
Exposure values travel as `QuantityField` (`focalLength`, `aperture`, `exposureTime`) so a unit
rides with each number instead of being implied by the field name. `flash` and `orientation` are
`CodedValueField`, because EXIF stores them as integers whose meaning lives in a vocabulary.
`cameraName` is computed from make and model.

Shared per metadata family rather than per file extension, so a capture reads the same whether the
bytes came from a JPEG, a HEIC or a raw file.

## Example
```ts
import { CameraCaptureField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(CameraCaptureField);
```
